title: Settings

subtitle.note: count is how many accounts there are.
count is how many folders and categories there are.
count is how many tags there are; a tag can be limited to some categories.
How many recurring rules (payments) are switched on.

open.note: How many debts are not paid back yet.

owedToYou.note: open is the "3 open" message; amount is money with its currency code ("1 200.00 UAH").

youOwe.note: open is the "3 open" message; amount is money with its currency code.

travel.title: Travel

on.note: Travel mode is running; trip is a short line about the trip (name, days left, spent).

onPlanned.note: The trip's last planned day has come; date is "22 Sep".

travel.off: Travel mode, and the trips you have been on

startDay.title: Budget month starts on

ordinal.note: A day of the month, as in "starts on the 22nd". day is 1–28.

calendar.note: Row subtitle when the budget month starts on the 1st.

custom.note: Row subtitle. ordinal is "22nd"; from and to are an example period, "22 Aug" and "21 Sep".

pickDay.note: Title of the list of days 1–28.

startDay.midMonth: Salary in the middle of the month

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.denied: Turned off in the Settings app
notifications.ask: Reminders before recurring payments are due

hideIncome.title: Hide income
hideIncome.on: Transactions shows expenses and transfers only
hideIncome.off: Show income in the Transactions list

showBalance.title: Show balance when logging
showBalance.on: The new-entry sheet opens with the balance before and after
showBalance.off: Folded behind the chevron until you tap it

location.title: Remember location
location.denied: Turned off in the Settings app
location.on: Suggests the category you used at the same place

home.title: Home

set.note: place is the home's place name, or its coordinates.

home.unset: Not set · skip category suggestions at home

explain.message: No category is suggested within {radius} m of home, since anything gets bought there.
explain.note: Alert message; radius is a number of metres.

home.noFixMessage: The phone has not got a fix yet. Try again in a moment, somewhere with a clearer view of the sky.

inventory.message: {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} · export, import, reset
inventory.note: Subtitle of the Data management row when there is nothing to say about backups.

failed.note: error is the system's message, usually in English.

off.note: inventory is the "120 transactions · export, import, reset" message.

local.message: {last} · iCloud is off, kept on this phone

none.note: inventory is the "120 transactions · export, import, reset" message.

shortcut.title: Automate with Shortcut
shortcut.subtitle: Log payments from your bank’s or Wallet’s notifications

subtitleOld.message: Log payments from your bank’s or Wallet’s notifications · needs iOS {version}
subtitleOld.note: On an iOS too old for the automation; version is "26".

beta.note: Small badge beside the Shortcut row in Settings: it works, but each bank still needs support added.

shortcut.settingsSubtitle: What it tells you, and what it could not read

about.privacySubtitle: What the app keeps, and where
about.diagnosticsSubtitle: Boot trace and the last recorded crash
about.testDataSubtitle: Replace everything with the screenshot dataset
about.testDataBody: Every account, entry and setting on this device is replaced by an invented dataset built for today. A backup of what is here now is written first.

testDataSafety.message: What was here is in the backup {name}.
testDataSafety.note: name is a backup file name.

foot: Local-first. Your data lives on this phone.
footICloud: Local-first. Your data lives on this phone, with backups in your iCloud Drive.

version.note: Footer; version is "1.0.3 (43)". The app's name as the App Store shows it.
